_readme: Multi-turn cases for npm run eval. Each turn is sent with the real earlier answers as history, as the chat UI does, and scored like a single case (types and keywords as in questions.json). expect_intent lists acceptable router decisions from the server log (an intent, 'fast_path', or 'fallback:*'). judge is a one-line rubric for the optional LLM judge (EVAL_JUDGE=1). Added 2026-11-15: no numeric result ('71%', '14 ms', '20-30') may appear in two consecutive answers of a conversation (checked in eval.ts for every conversation); max_words as in questions.json.
